result.summary: The page is generally well-laid-out, but a loading spinner is rendered on top of the 'Popular right now' card image, making that section look broken or stuck in a loading state.

issues.description: A loading spinner appears in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image in the 'Popular right now' section, overlaying the image content as if the image never finished loading.
issues.suggestion: Load the actual image (or a proper placeholder/thumbnail) and ensure the spinner is removed once loading completes; investigate why it remains overlaid on the card.
